newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia state oil company's February exports drop.
newsitem.headline: Colombia state oil company's February exports drop.

text.p: Colombia's state-run oil company Ecopetrol saw its crude exports fall 22 percent to an average of about 161,000 barrels per day last month compared to January, a company spokesman said Monday.
The spokesman was unable to give an explanation for the drop of 48,000 barrels per day in exports and was unaware whether it had been prompted by a fall in production.
The value of Ecopetrol's exports was $89.6 million, taking the combine dvalue for the the first two months of the year to $164.2 million.

Ecopetrol produces a daily average of 121,700 barrels in the fields it operates on its own. Production from fields it operates in association with private sector companies amounts to more than 500,000 barrels per day.
